additional_info.subject: RE: FW: RE: ID0382513-DC/Si-D/VN-[MP / R3 170001682] Scrambled Screen CRM:01811000367
additional_info.body:
Hi Edna,
As discussed over the call, the direct repalcement of “8EM5903-0AA01-7AA0” Gen 1 HMI, Control Panel, without AC Socket, requires following two parts :
8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0 : Controlpanel CCR Contactless no AC Gen2
8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6 : Controlpanel Adaptation Set Gen1 / Gen2
This is also described in the spare part list.
SICHARGE D HW rev. 0 Spare Part List - ID: 109814736 - Industry Support Siemens
Ankita, missed to mention this in the email on ISP cases, however she had clarified this to you by MS Teams Chat, apologies for the inconvenience caused, I will take this with me to improve the communication from NOC,
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita Khobare
